encoded.stillness_intent: Employee has put unused choices down and waits; door remains unfinished.
encoded.limits: Frame coverage and static hold are technical observations, not proof of the intended causal reading.

layout_warnings.message: Rotating element's bounding-box center drifts 17px across rotation — it is not spinning about its own center (check transformOrigin/svgOrigin).
layout_warnings.fixHint: The bounding-box center should stay fixed while the element spins; check its transformOrigin/svgOrigin so rotation pivots about the element's own center rather than a point in a coordinate space it was resized out of.

technical_check.warning_disposition: Intentional upper-neck rotation pivot. A face rotating about its neck moves its bounding-box center; no centered-spin behavior was intended. Strict check remains false and is not described as all-green.

live_preview.endpoint_behavior: At the exact12-second composition endpoint the player hides the composition; no encoded frame is blank.

causal_review.scope: Whether this staging visibly establishes that the owner enables work and her absence blocks a fresh task.
causal_review.finding: Departure is clear, but the enabling decision, task and resulting stoppage remain ambiguous.
causal_review.limits: Two agent contact-sheet reads at2fps, first unprimed and second with owner/employee roles supplied, plus root encoded-contact-sheet and browser-frame inspection. This is neither human audience testing nor a controlled full-motion comprehension experiment.
causal_review.director_judgment: Do not integrate this test into the full episode yet. The causal action needs clearer staging; fewer headings alone did not establish added value. Human anatomy and interaction remain rough, so this is not finished illustration.
